'''Garen''' was a King of [[Dhowlan]].

== History ==
King Garen was involved in several wars against neighboring [[Farashelle]]. 

The cliff of [[Garen's Wall]] is named for the king, because of the defense that it provided against Farashelle.{{ref/book|twotc}}
